title: Alvanon avatars
content:
I would like to work with Alvanons avatars in clo can anyone guide me how to set up them in clo?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There. You can definitely use Digital Alvanon forms in CLO.To do so you will need to upload an Alvanon Permission File. More infrmation about that can be found here : https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/70542b6fb3524c4ba47c6c80b74cadec you have the permission file from Alvanon you can upload it to CLO in User Settings. Information about that can be found here - https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/70542b6fb3524c4ba47c6c80b74cadec
content_description: This page provides guidance on how to set up and use Alvanon avatars within CLO software.

This dress is a sophisticated, vintage-inspired long-sleeve midi dress in a vibrant turquoise shade. It features structured shoulder pads, giving it a bold, powerful silhouette reminiscent of classic tailored designs. The collar is elongated and tied into a soft bow, with a keyhole cutout just beneath for a subtle touch of elegance. The bodice is fitted with decorative stitching and button detailing running down the center, enhancing the waistline. The skirt flares out gently from the waist, creating a flowy, graceful look. This style combines vintage charm with a modern, polished vibe — perfect for formal gatherings or a statement work outfit.

title: Turned option on Seam not exported to xml meta file
content:
Hello,

  
I am exporting meta data along with obj from CLO.  
But I noticed that when I tick "Turned" on a Seam, it just exports whatever values were used for Fold Strength and Fold Angle before I clicked turned to the meta data file.  
There is no information about the status of the Turned checkbox in the meat xml file.  
And obviously, if I wanted to use the Fold information for rendering, etc, I would work with incorrect data if Turned is ticked.  
I hope this makes sense.

Am I missing something?

Is there a way to get the information into the meta file?

Cheers,  
Sebastian

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Sebastian, we will get back to you asap!
content_description: A support page addressing issues with exporting accurate seam metadata from CLO, specifically regarding the "Turned" checkbox not being reflected in the exported meta XML file.

title: exploding garment animation
content:
i followed the tutorial: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CrCs-yNL5EY>  
When using a garment that has gathers and pleats, theses do not turn flat during the animation. How can I fix this?   


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/25f6fc0b0f3e443baa1f99b017c69389/images/215525c0d4b54af08ab2d3f30a4fc181blouse%20morph%20target_Default%20Colorway_30.png)

How can I fix this?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, for the exploded state, arrange the pattern pieces on the arrangement points of the avatar, this will remove any pleating and gathering. (Please also make sure to turn Seam Face ON for all pattern pieces in order to avoid incompatiblity between both states.)
content_description: This page provides solutions and tips for fixing gathers and pleats that do not flatten correctly during garment animation in 3D modeling.

title: Lost Projects
content:
I downloaded the new update and when I tried to open my projects I just saved less than an hour ago, they all disappeared. I'm very frustrated and annoyed.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, did you save your projects within the CLO assets folders? If yes, they unfortuentely cannot be recovered. If this is not the case, the link in the library might be gone, but the files should still be on your computer.
Reply 1: omg this just happened to me you're sayign everything i worked for for the last few months is gone???
Reply 2: Hi Safia, sorry for the late reply. If you did save your files in CLO assets folders, then this can unfortunately be the case. Always create your own folder structure on your computer or a cloud.
content_description: This page provides support and solutions for users experiencing missing or lost projects after updating their software.
